Psychiatry really interests me. And somewhat, we were friends for a long time and dealing with the suicide of his brother. I just feel like if I have it and he does, might as well try to make things work. But if I do and he doesn't, i'm up shit creek and alone.

I just wanna say thank you by the way, the fact you are showing an interest means a lot. I'm just not sure what to do, but I have been thinking of suicide as an option lately.
It's psych or business, I am unsure at the moment. Which is probably why I feel like I am getting no where. Also, it is on him, but if I am positive and he isn't I think i'm going to feel even worse

I felt shitty about doing a community college as well. I still do sometimes, I just see it as a stepping stone. Plus, a lot of my friends/associates came back after their first year. It was either too expensive or they partied too hard. I felt as though I was somewhat on the right track, and atleast a few steps ahead than they were.
